title: An Old Friend Visits
next_chapter_hook: The voice continued: 'You thought the Tianji Record was something you obtained by chance?' The voice carried an indescribable undertone. 'Everything, from the day you were born, was already destined.'

text.content:
The night wind was like a blade. In the Bamboo Grove at the Back Mountain of Tianqing Sect, the bamboo leaves rustled, like thousands of tiny fingers gently plucking at something.

Chen Ji sat cross-legged on a blue stone, the Tianji Record Fragment hovering before him, emanating a faint blue glow. His brow furrowed slightly—unsure why, but tonight's moonlight seemed exceptionally cold, and upon that fragment, an imperceptible fluctuation was faintly emerging.

It was a breath he had never sensed before.

Not hostility, nor goodwill, but something deeper, something more ancient. Like someone gazing at him from a great distance, or perhaps like something standing merely three feet behind him.

Chen Ji did not open his eyes.

His right hand quietly slipped into his sleeve, touching the warm Turtle Shell artifact. The moment it made contact, a long-missed tremor traveled from his fingertips—the Turtle Shell was trembling lightly.

'Who?' Chen Ji's voice was calm as ever, betraying not a trace of disturbance.

Deep within the Bamboo Grove, something was slowly approaching.

dialogue.content:
No response.

Only the wind, only the rustling of bamboo leaves, and—the Turtle Shell's increasingly violent trembling.

Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes.

Moonlight flowed like water, spilling across the blue stone before him, yet at the edges of that glow, faint distortions rippled. As if something was attempting to squeeze into this world from the boundary between light and shadow.

'Still not coming out?' Chen Ji's voice remained placid, though a thread of spiritual power had quietly gathered at his fingertips.

'Coming out?'

A voice suddenly resonated within his mind.

The voice bypassed his ears entirely, appearing directly in the depths of his consciousness, as if arriving from the primordial chaos of antiquity, or surging forth from the deepest recesses of his soul.

'I never left.'

There was no hostility in that voice, even carrying a hint of warm amusement. Yet that amusement, falling upon Chen Ji's ears, sent a sudden sheen of cold sweat across his back.

Because he recognized this voice.

During countless nights spent using the Tianji Record to peer into the future, this voice had appeared countless times at the blurred edges of those visions. That existence perpetually hidden in shadow, guiding him step by step to this very moment.

That which he referred to as his 'benefactor'—

—Mysterious Person.

text.content:
Chen Ji's fingers tightened slightly.

He showed no panic, not even a flicker in his gaze. This was skill honed over many years—no matter what turbulent waves churned within, on the surface it was always that unruffled demeanor.

'So it was you.' His voice was terrifyingly calm. 'I've been waiting for you for a long time.'

The moment his words fell, the Turtle Shell artifact in his sleeve suddenly erupted with blinding golden light. That radiance shot skyward, illuminating the entire Bamboo Grove as bright as day.

And within that golden light, a blurred silhouette was slowly taking shape.

Not human form.

It was an existence beyond verbal description. It possessed no fixed shape, sometimes like smoke, sometimes like mist, and at other moments assuming even more诡异 forms. The only clear feature was a single eye, slowly opening, positioned at the center of that mass.

That eye was pure gold, its pupil seemingly containing star maps of the entire universe.

Chen Ji stared fixedly at that eye, a strange sense of familiarity surging in his heart.

'What are you looking at?' he asked.

The mass of existence gave no answer, merely that golden eye blinking, as if examining an interesting toy.

The next instant, that voice sounded again:

'It seems you've finally earned the right to see me.'

Bamboo leaves rustled; under the golden light's reflection, the moonlight appeared pale and powerless.

Chen Ji rose to his feet. The Tianji Record Fragment automatically flew into his palm. He could sense the runes upon the fragment racing frantically, as if responding to something.

And that golden eye still gazed at him quietly.

'Earned the right?' A slight curve lifted at Chen Ji's mouth. 'I thought I was merely dancing upon your chessboard this whole time.'

The mass of existence did not deny this.

'Chessboard?' That voice carried a hint of amusement. 'If you were merely a piece, this game would be far too interesting.'

Chen Ji offered no retort. His gaze swept across that blurred existence, then fell upon the Turtle Shell in his own hand. The artifact still vibrated, but the frequency was gradually stabilizing, as if awaiting something.

'Do you know what this Turtle Shell is?' he suddenly asked.

The mass of existence fell silent for a moment.

'Did you leave it for me?' Chen Ji pressed on, his voice betraying no emotion whatsoever.

This time, that voice finally responded:

'It has been waiting for you all along. You simply didn't know.'

Before the words even finished, the silhouette of that existence suddenly began to fluctuate violently. That golden eye began collapsing inward, as if preparing to merge into the void.

'Wait.' Chen Ji stepped forward. 'Who exactly are you? Why have you remained by my side? The truth of the Tianji Record—'

'Truth?' That voice cut him off. 'You wish to know the truth?'

The golden eye opened once more, and this time, within its pupil was reflected an image.

It was an infant, lying in a crude cradle. And that infant's eyes—those eyes not yet opened—actually gleamed with the exact same light as that golden eye.

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

'Who do you think created you?'

text.content:
'Speak!' Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose, spiritual power凝聚at his fingertips into a sharp radiance. 'Where did the Tianji Record come from? What exactly is your relationship with me? If you truly are my creator—then let me ask you, what was your purpose in creating me?'

The mass of existence paused for an instant, seemingly unprepared for such directness.

'Purpose?' That voice fell silent for a moment. 'You think I created you with some purpose?'

The golden eye flickered.

'Interesting.' That voice actually carried a thread of approval. 'You are more... interesting than I anticipated.'

Before the words even finished, that mass of existence abruptly surged forward, the pressure bearing down like a mountain collapsing. Chen Ji's feet sank deep into the blue stone; the Turtle Shell artifact trembled even more violently.

'Since you wish to know—' That voice turned abruptly cold. 'Then see for yourself with your own eyes.'

A beam of golden light shot forth from that eye, piercing directly into Chen Ji's brow center.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak.

He simply stood there quietly, his gaze tranquil as still water, as if facing an unimportant passerby. That mass of existence seemed to sense something; the golden eye narrowed slightly.

'No more questions?' That voice carried a playful tone. 'I thought you would be very eager to know the answers.'

'Answers?' Chen Ji finally spoke, his voice betraying no emotion. 'If you were willing to speak, I would know even without asking. If you weren't willing, asking would be pointless.'

That mass of existence fell silent.

After a long while, that golden eye blinked, and within its depths, a trace of amusement actually appeared.

'Truly interesting.' The emotion within that voice grew complex. 'No wonder the Tianji Record chose you.'

Before the words even finished, the silhouette of that mass of existence began to dissolve, the golden eye gradually growing dim.

'Wait—' Chen Ji stepped forward, but that existence was on the verge of completely vanishing into the void.

'We shall meet again.' That voice drifted from the distance, carrying an indescribable profundity. 'After all, you are my most proud—'

The voice cut off abruptly.

That mass of existence had utterly vanished, leaving only a silent Bamboo Grove and faint golden motes lingering in the air.

text.content:
Chen Ji's expression shifted subtly; his eyes, originally calm as still water, now flickered with a trace of... confusion?

'Creator...' His voice dropped lower. 'You mean, the Tianji Record, the Turtle Shell, and me—'

He lowered his head, as if digesting this shocking revelation. That mass of existence watched him silently, the golden eye flickering with some unfathomable light.

'What else do you wish to ask?' That voice carried a hint of warmth. 'I rarely make an appearance.'

Chen Ji raised his head, his eyes flickering with a fragile light.

'I...' He paused. 'I wish to know, what is the meaning of my existence?'

That mass of existence clearly startled.

'Meaning?' That voice repeated the word, as if savoring its flavor. 'A good question. Unfortunately—'

The golden eye suddenly wide-opened, a terrifying aura sweeping forth.

'I dislike being tested.'

Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, yet the corner of his mouth lifted slightly.

'Seen through?' His voice returned to calm, even carrying a hint of amusement. 'As expected, nothing escapes your notice.'

That mass of existence fell silent for a moment.

'You are more... interesting than I anticipated.' The emotion within that voice grew even more complex. 'No wonder the Tianji Record chose you.'

That mass of existence slowly drew closer, the golden eye practically pressing against Chen Ji's face.

'Since you wish to know—' That voice became low and authoritative. 'Then I shall tell you one thing.'

'The Tianji Record chose you, not because of your talent, not because of your luck, and certainly not because of your efforts.'

'But because—'

That voice echoed within Chen Ji's mind, each word striking his soul like a heavy hammer:

'You were born for this very purpose.'

The words fell; that mass of existence began to dissolve.

'Wait!' Chen Ji pressed. 'The Turtle Shell—'

'It will tell you the answer.' That voice had already become ethereal. 'The前提 is—you are qualified to wield it.'

Golden light scattered; the Bamboo Grove returned to silence.

Only Chen Ji remained, standing beneath the moonlight, clutching that Turtle Shell still faintly trembling.

'Born for this purpose...' He murmured the words, a cold glint flickering in his eyes.

'Hmph.'

Chen Ji lowered his head, gazing at the Turtle Shell in his hand.

The artifact's trembling had ceased, yet upon its surface, a faint layer of golden patterns had emerged. Those patterns were intricate and precise, like some ancient runes, or perhaps part of some formation.

This was a change he had never witnessed since obtaining the Turtle Shell.
